Card Q&A.q: What are the Digmon I can have that will allow me to ignore this card's color requirements according to its 1st effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't play a [WarGrowlmon] Token. When a card has "ACE" written in its name, "ACE" isn't included in the card name.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to play a [WarGrowlmon] Token,  [Taomon] Token, and [Rapidmon] Token when I have [WarGrowlmon ACE]?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. The tokens played by this card's [Main] effect don't have a level. You can only choose your level 5 Digimon for the part of this card's [Main] effect after "then," therefore you can't choose these tokens.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose 1 of the played tokens for the part of this card's [Main] effect after "then," give  to that Digimon twice, and attack with it?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. The Digimon that was given  twice must attack if possible.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to give  to a Digimon twice, but choose to not attack with it?
What cards can be played using this card's [Security] effect?

Effect: While you have a level 5 [WarGrowlmon], [Taomon] or [Rapidmon], you may ignore this card's color requirements.

[Main] Play 1 [WarGrowlmon] Token (Digimon/red/6000 DP), 1 [Taomon] Token (Digimon/yellow/6000 DP) and 1 [Rapidmon] Token (Digimon/green/6000 DP). This effect can't play Tokens with the same names as your Digimon. Then, 1 of your level 5 Digimon gains ＜Alliance＞ twice for the turn and attacks.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 level 5 [WarGrowlmon], [Taomon] or [Rapidmon] from your hand without paying the cost.
